    if i in issues:item['observation']=issues[i]
    r.append(item)
out={'candidate_identity':p['candidate_identity'],'contract':'translation_surface_screen_v1','results':r}
assert len(r)==20
assert [x['entry_revision_identity'] for x in r]==[e['entry_revision_identity'] for e in p['payload']['entries']]
assert len({x['entry_revision_identity'] for x in r})==20
assert all(len(x['entry_revision_identity'])==64 for x in r)
print(json.dumps(out,ensure_ascii=False,sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':')),end='')
